svg.text: (a) Required invocations per function (median over runs)
The three runs of the replicate series. 37 functions repay at their median, spanning 4.5 orders of magnitude (1.48e+04 to
4.34e+08); 18 never repay. In (b) lines are means over runs, bands the lowest to highest run; ticks at the top are each run's
portfolio break-even (translate all 7.9 x 10^5 to 9.3 x 10^5; skip cloud functions 1.2 x 10^8 to 2.0 x 10^8; prediction gate 6.8
x 10^5 to 1.0 x 10^6; oracle 1.6 x 10^5 to 2.3 x 10^5). The gate acts through out-of-fold decisions of the model fitted on these
